title: Session personnel and how Lloyd became a drummer
summary: Musicians on the session; Lloyd took up drums at the Lamp Post on Bourbon; Janellis engineered in his front room.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Well, the president at the local during that time, Lewis Contrell, and the boy that did the section was Lord Washington, Poirier, and myself and, uh, who was that fellow, that bass player, man? Uh, uh, uh, Kimball. Norvin Kimball. Norvin Kimball. Norvin Kimball, yeah.
Lloyd played drumming on the section.
How did it happen he was playing drums then?

Uh, what happened that, we had a little group at the, uh, Lamp Post on Bourbon and the Sinan, right across from Pete Fountain Place, and, uh, we was, uh, Lori and I was working together. You know you'd like to do the ink spot thing. Mm-hmm. And, uh, so we just had a piano, just me on piano, so we decided to try to fully in a little mode. We couldn't do ink spot numbers all night long. It got monotonous. So I had Lloyd, Lloyd rented an old drum. And so Lloyd started playing drums along with me. And then after that, then, business pick up kind of good. Then the fellas told me to get a few more pieces. That's how I ate it on Kilman Puri. And kept Lloyd playing drums.
You know, I never did know that Lloyd was a drummer before that. I don't remember playing that.
Well, Lloyd wasn't. I never remember Lloyd being a drummer myself before that.
No. He just picked it up.
Yeah. Just happened to pick it up. Played real nice time, too.
Yeah. Did you do all those, make up all those numbers yourself?
Oh, uh, did that guy have anybody else there at the session? Did he have his, who was the engineer? I forgot to ask you that.
He was the engineer. Yeah? Yeah. He had his little machine that sit up. He did it himself, right in his front room.
And it was his wife or children or anybody around?
Well, yeah. His wife was around.
So, it was just like being at home or something? Yeah, just like being at home. Did you get your kicks?
I got plenty of kicks, man. Yeah. Everybody got the kicks at the little section. They were real nice. So, I'm sorry that nothing could have happened with the numbers. So, we're here trying again.
